content:
Arcadia's Uzbekistan trips are private, family-oriented programs that combine the magic of the ancient Silk Road, timeless historic cities and authentic experiences with an Arabic- or English-speaking guide. This page explains why 2026 is the right year, what each city offers, the activities we add to every program, and our packages at a glance.

Why choose Uzbekistan with Arcadia in 2026?

  • New developments: Afrosiyob high-speed trains, new 5-star hotels in Khiva and Samarkand, and a renovated Tashkent airport.
  • Perfect weather: April–June and September–October are the best months (20–28°C).
  • Exclusive touches: stays in traditional caravanserai-style guesthouses, private cooking workshops and sunset tours.
  • Quality assurance: Arab guides, private transportation, travel insurance and a 24/7 WhatsApp line.

The main tourist cities of Uzbekistan

1. Tashkent, gateway to Central Asia

The modern capital combines ancient mosques with grand Soviet architecture. Highlights: the Hazrati Imam complex with the Uthman Quran (one of the oldest in the world), Chorsu Bazaar, and the Chimgan cable car an hour from the city. With Arcadia: an evening city tour and dinner in a traditional restaurant.

2. Samarkand, jewel of the Silk Road

The most beautiful city in Central Asia and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Highlights: Registan Square with its three madrasas, the Gur-e-Amir mausoleum of Tamerlane, Shah-i-Zinda and the Ulugh Beg Observatory. With Arcadia: a private sunset tour and an Uzbek bread-making workshop.

3. Bukhara, the holy city

More than 140 historic monuments in a walkable old town often called the "museum city". Highlights: the Poi Kalon complex and Kalon Minaret, the Ark Fortress and Ulugh Beg madrasa, and Lyabi-Hauz with the silk markets. With Arcadia: a stay in a traditional courtyard hotel and a horse-carriage tour.

4. Khiva, the walled city

The best-preserved walled city in Central Asia, an open-air museum. Highlights: Itchan Kala (the complete inner city), the Islam Khoja Minaret, the Kunya-Ark fortress and the Tash Hauli Palace. With Arcadia: a folklore show inside the walls.

Distinctive activities on Arcadia trips

  • Taste authentic Uzbek plov in a cooking workshop with a local family.
  • Visit the green Fergana Valley and its silk markets in Margilan.
  • A day trip to the Chatkal Mountains or Charvak Lake for relaxation.
  • Attend the 2026 festivals (Nowruz, Sharq Taronalari, the Silk and Spices Festival).
  • Luxury train journeys between the cities.

Practical tips

  • Visa: visa-free for Gulf nationals (30 days); e-visa for other Arab nationalities, which we help arrange.
  • Transportation: direct flights to Tashkent, high-speed trains and private cars.
  • Accommodation: 4–5 star hotels or traditional guesthouses, as you prefer.
  • Budget: packages from about 850 USD per person for 10 days, all inclusive except flights.
  • Safety: Uzbekistan is one of the safest countries in the region for Arab tourists.

Prices depend on season and hotel level (4-star or heritage boutique hotels by default, 5-star on request). Lower in July–August and December–February, higher in April–May and September–October.

What every package includes

  • Hotels with breakfast: international hotels in Tashkent, heritage hotels inside the old cities of Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva.
  • Afrosiyob high-speed train tickets between cities, booked in advance.
  • A private car with driver in every city and an Arabic- or English-speaking guide on tour days.
  • Entrance tickets to all monuments in the program and airport transfers.
  • A local office on WhatsApp throughout the trip; halal food is universal in Uzbekistan.

Family and pilgrimage options

Pool hotels in summer, connecting rooms, a slower pace with midday rests, and visits to the shrines of Imam al-Bukhari, Baha-ud-Din Naqshband and Imam al-Tirmidhi with time for prayer. See the best things to do in Uzbekistan, the 7-day program and tourism in Uzbekistan, then send your dates and the children's ages on WhatsApp +7 706 400 7561 for a fixed-price program within 24 hours.
